SnowDistribution: A cover of soft snow above 800 metres, a dusting below. Good visibility with occasional low cloud over the tops. Winds 30 mph progress difficult at times with stronger gusts.
Comment: Avalanche hazard will gradually increase to moderate as the day progresses
WeatherInfluences: Dry for most of the night before the arrival of snowfall, initially above 500 metres then rising 800 to 1000 metres by midday. South-South-East winds will be gale to severe gale force. A complex freezing level with summit temperatures on average around minus 3 Celsius.
SnowStability:
As the day progresses unstable windslab will become more widespread on West through North to North-East aspects above 1000 metres. The greatest instability will be in steep locations such as gullies, gully exits, coire
rims and convexities. On these aspects, fragile cornices will develop. The avalanche hazard will be Moderate.
ObservedWeatherInfluences: A dry day with strong Southerly winds. The midday freezing level was around 800 metres.
ObservedSnowStability: Unstable windslab is lying on West through North to North-East aspects mainly above 1000 metres.  These accumulations are mostly isolated, and in some areas localised with the greatest instability being in steep locations such as coire rims and the tops of gullies.  The avalanche hazard is Low.
